reviews.text: Highly recommend Gene & his crew, he came & gave me a quote one day & was back the next morning ready to go. Cleanup was excellent, not a leaf left on the ground anywhere.

Gene and the crew came out and removed a tree this morning. The guys were professional and cleaned up all tree waste. This is the second time using Country Vic Tree Removal and both times the work was outstanding.
They have the best equipment to get the job done efficiently and safely. Clean up was also A1. Very reasonable price.
Gene arrived on time for the quote and gave an accurate assessment. The guys cleaned up and I even got some logs cut to size for the fire!
